description: Data from the two supplied archived plots; later monitoring entries are excluded.
metric: Approximate reconstructed GraphCast loss reduction at 240 h (%)
weighting: Latitude-weighted channel RMSE squared, divided by per-level difference variance; pressure/mean-pressure weighting averaged across levels; GraphCast variable weights.
metric_limitation: Exact GraphCast pole weighting cannot be recovered from saved channel RMSEs.
label_note: The archived ar_tail_K=0 runs are labelled K=1 (teacher forcing), matching main_v3; K=20 retains its feedback-tail meaning.
marker_note: SWA markers are positioned at the averaging-window midpoint; x does not identify a single checkpoint.
